embeds.title: 🔥 THE TIME GATE OPENS — THE KING FACES THE IMPOSSIBLE
embeds.description:
*A cinematic chronicle from the Ashen Kingdom — concept story for a possible future chapter.*

The sky above the burning colosseum splits open.

Beyond the ruins, an ancient Time Gate rises from the flames. A colossal lava titan stirs, its molten eyes fixed upon the lone warrior standing beneath the shattered towers.

👑 The King tightens his grip on the sword. Behind him: an army of skeletons. Ahead: an enemy that could swallow entire kingdoms.

**This is no longer a battle for the throne. It is a battle for time itself.**

⚔️ **Ideas for future chapters:**
• Arenas across different eras
• A royal skill tree
• Legendary armor sets
• Allies fighting beneath the King's banner
• An endless survival challenge

*These are creative concepts, not features currently available in the game.*

🔥 The original battle is already yours to fight. Enter the arena and face the undead in **King of Ash**.

🎮 **PLAY NOW:** https://playgama.ai/play/w6vamsre5drpbe
